The '''Financial Funnel''' was the name given affectionately to a [[Skyhook/Legends|Skyhook]] on the planet [[Muunilinst/Legends|Muunilinst]]. It linked the orbital [[High Port Space Center]] with the [[Muun/Legends|Muun]] planetary capital of [[Harnaidan]].
